text:
elaine: quick sync 1 1 brainstorming the benchmark creative + launch funnel. low-key, here are raw notes.
jorge: cool, put bullets. want a single hero stat + 3 supporting charts.
elaine: hero mock: "Reduce inference spend ~2.6x while meeting p95 latency targets". concise, but we should validate.
sam: prefer 'while keeping p95 < 200ms' if data supports. users care about latency SLOs, investors care about multiplier.
maria: funnel: social -> landing w/ ROI calc -> webinar signups -> trial. landing must be tight and single-CTA.
neil: chart set idea: 1) Cost-per-1M-tokens (bar) by model+quant; 2) p50/p95/p99 stacked bar or small-multiple tails; 3) cost vs latency tradeoff curve (knee plot). include a mini inset on cache/batching impact.
elaine: language: 'Cost per 1M inference tokens' vs 'Tokens per $' ? which reads better on slide?
jorge: I vote 'Cost per 1M tokens ($)'. explicit.
sam: methods blurb: keep short: 'Tests run on representative open models; see appendix for hardware and prompt suite.' legal ok?
neil: sounds fine. avoid naming specific GPU models on hero. appendix can have details.
maria: webinar format: 20m customer story, 15m demo, 25m live q&a. promotions: newsletter, targeted LinkedIn, and a dev-focused Twitter thread.
elaine: inbound routing rules: if trial starts and first-week usage > 10M tokens OR billing estimate > $200/mo -> AE outreach. also flag if p95 < 150ms at >500 rps.
jorge: lower threshold for SMB nurture: 1M tokens -> automated email + ROI calc nudge.
sam: data ask: we'll provide csv of raw numbers + visual-friendly aggregates. include confidence intervals.
neil: visual notes: design for mobile/social crops (1:1) and deck (16:9). use a single color palette, highlight Redwood bar.
maria: CTA copy A/B test: 'Calculate your inference ROI' vs 'See how much you could save on inference'. we'll test click-through and signups.
elaine: social one-liner for release: 'Ship faster, pay less: typical customers see ~2.6x lower inference spend at production latencies.' keep conservative.
jorge: I'll draft three headline variants and two subheads by EOD.
sam: data timeline: deliver numbers + appendix by Thu EOD. neil to push mockups Thu night.
neil: will do mocks; will also generate a lightweight alt layout for homepage hero.
ops-bot: reminder: landing content freeze Friday 09:00 PT.
maria: I'll wire the routing logic with ops and create lead_score mapping.
elaine: action items: (1) jorge 3 hero headlines (2) sam data + csv (3) neil mockups + social crops (4) maria landing + routing map. lock hero & chart slate Thu EOD. any blockers?
jorge: none from my side.
sam: none.
neil: all good.
elaine: perfect. thanks team :party_parrot:
